nodes.title: Platform foundation
nodes.purpose: Shared reference platform and proposed assessment scope.
nodes.usage: Explore the packages and management plane.

nodes.title: RKE2
nodes.usage: Hosts platform services and scoped tenant workloads.
nodes.runbook: Review prerequisites, readiness and recovery before operating.

nodes.title: Flux
nodes.purpose: Reconciles reviewed desired state from Git.
nodes.usage: Use Git changes for application reconciliation.
nodes.configuration: Platform bootstrap selects sources and reconciliation scopes.
nodes.runbook: Review source identity and reconciliation evidence; this portal cannot reconcile.

nodes.title: Big Bang
nodes.purpose: Curates platform packages and their configuration.
nodes.usage: Select reviewed packages for the target.
nodes.configuration: Package values, prerequisites and pinned source belong in platform Git.
nodes.runbook: Render and test the actual selected packages before adoption.

nodes.title: Rancher · PE only
nodes.configuration: Not an application GitOps owner or tenant UI.
nodes.runbook: Follow reviewed infrastructure guidance; no administrative controls here.

nodes.title: Keycloak
nodes.purpose: Shared identity provider and signed identity claims.
nodes.usage: Sign in to appropriately configured applications.
nodes.configuration: Each relying party validates audience, client, roles and group policy.
nodes.runbook: Review identity configuration and access tests; SSO alone grants no resource access.

nodes.title: Headlamp
nodes.purpose: Tenant-facing Kubernetes UI in the reference design.
nodes.usage: Inspect only resources authorized by Kubernetes RBAC.
nodes.configuration: Keep user identity and namespace permissions scoped; no token fallback.
nodes.runbook: Verify permitted and denied operations for the actual target.

nodes.title: OpenBao · planned
nodes.usage: Not selected or represented as deployed.
nodes.configuration: Requires explicit package selection and reviewed prerequisites.
nodes.runbook: Plan unseal, backup, recovery and access validation before adoption.

nodes.title: Example tenant boundary
nodes.purpose: Generic tenant scope; no real tenant inventory.
nodes.usage: Understand workload, data and responsibility separation.
nodes.configuration: Enrollment Git owns foundations; application Git owns deployments.
nodes.runbook: Require current positive and negative isolation evidence.

nodes.title: Tenant workloads
nodes.purpose: Application execution within a scoped tenant design.
nodes.usage: Use approved artifact identities and reviewed application configuration.
nodes.configuration: Namespace, service accounts and permissions require enforced policy.
nodes.runbook: Validate runtime, network, quota, admission and recovery boundaries.

nodes.title: Tenant data
nodes.purpose: Logical data scope with tenant-owned classification and retention.
nodes.usage: Store and access data through authorized applications.
nodes.configuration: Storage and backup policies require target-specific review.
nodes.runbook: Demonstrate restore and cross-tenant denial; namespace labels are insufficient.

nodes.title: PerkForge Portal
nodes.purpose: Visual documentation and a session-protected tenant directory.
nodes.usage: Explore sanitized documentation; sign in for your scoped workspace.
nodes.configuration: React + Fastify BFF; GitLab integration is disabled.
nodes.runbook: Run local checks; identity and deployment require separate review.

nodes.title: External image source
nodes.purpose: Untrusted upstream artifact origin for the proposed intake journey.
nodes.usage: Resolve an allowlisted source to immutable platform digests.
nodes.configuration: No imported image execution or Docker socket.
nodes.runbook: Reject missing coverage or identity drift.

nodes.title: GitLab CI + Trivy · planned
nodes.purpose: Future isolated validation and CVE scanning before publication.
nodes.usage: Scan every copied platform; retain SBOM and gate evidence.
nodes.configuration: Protected publisher separated from untrusted MR validation.
nodes.runbook: Fail on stale DB, findings per policy, errors, tampering or incomplete evidence.

nodes.title: Harbor · planned
nodes.purpose: Future approved image and chart registry.
nodes.usage: Publish exact validated content through a protected publisher.
nodes.configuration: Scoped robot permissions and immutable tags require review.
nodes.runbook: Verify read-back digests; later rescans complement intake gates.

views.title: The whole platform
views.summary: A map of the reference design, from shared foundations to tenant workloads.

views.title: Inside the foundation
views.summary: Big Bang supplies packages. Flux reconciles applications. Rancher stays with platform engineering.

views.title: Identity is a starting point
views.summary: Keycloak supplies identity. Each application and Kubernetes enforce their own authorization decisions.

views.title: Platform authorization scope
views.summary: Proposed shared-platform assessment scope and dependencies. Scope remains subject to authorizing-official review.

views.title: Inside a tenant boundary
views.summary: A generic tenant scope with shared services outside it. A box does not enforce isolation.

views.title: From external image to workload
views.summary: External image → GitLab validation / Trivy → Harbor → Flux desired-state review → workloads. Flux carries references, while the runtime pulls bytes from Harbor.

steps.title: Resolve the source
steps.body: Allowlist source and destination. Resolve once to immutable manifest and runnable platform digests.

steps.title: Validate and scan
steps.body: Isolated GitLab jobs run Trivy for every copied platform. Missing coverage, stale databases, errors and policy failures block publication.

steps.title: Publish exact content
steps.body: A separately permissioned publisher verifies producer identity, gate evidence and hashes, then verifies Harbor read-back digests.

steps.title: Review desired state
steps.body: A reviewed Git change pins approved artifact references. Flux reconciles that desired state; it does not move image bytes.

steps.title: Run and verify
steps.body: The runtime pulls the approved digest from Harbor. Admission and runtime permissions still require separate validation.

steps.title: Enter the portal
steps.body: The browser holds an opaque secure session cookie. Access tokens stay in server memory.

steps.title: Verify identity and policy
steps.body: The BFF validates signature, issuer, audience, authorized client, API role and the configured exact group policy.

steps.title: Read scoped data
steps.body: The tenant BFF traverses bearer API validation. The adapter is disabled or fixture-only; no live GitLab requests occur.
